rows.name: Python standard library random.choice with a byte-preserving filter
rows.reason: Same-case ASCII substitution preserves exact word lengths, punctuation and line-break bytes while producing random gibberish. Requires wrapper; pronounceability unguaranteed. Verified API documentation is live, not a retrieved pre-cutoff snapshot.

rows.name: Thinkzone Gibberish Generator
rows.reason: Input-driven statistical gibberish lacks confirmed word-length/separator correspondence; punctuation/whitespace cautions remain. JavaScript source retrieval failed; exact software-license scope and Linux support unverified.

rows.name: Python str.translate with a one-to-one letter mapping
rows.reason: Concrete non-identity ASCII ROT13 mapping preserves exact word lengths, punctuation, spaces and line breaks: maketrans maps equal-length strings, translate retains unmapped characters. Python licensing/Linux support verified.

rows.name: Lorem Picsum
rows.reason: Lorem Picsum generates placeholder photographs with requested image dimensions; it accepts no source paragraph and provides no mechanism for replacing text while preserving word lengths or punctuation.

rows.name: GNU coreutils tr with an ASCII letter substitution
rows.reason: One-for-one ASCII substitution preserves word lengths, capitalization, punctuation, spaces and line breaks. ROT13 is deterministic/reversible; pronounceability and identical proportional-font widths are not guaranteed.

rows.name: Gibberify
rows.reason: Gibberify is a GPL-3.0 Python gibberish generator requiring adaptation. Original lengths, punctuation and line breaks are not promised; it is not a verified drop-in match. Release date unverified.

rows.name: Python str.translate with a one-to-one letter mapping
rows.reason: A one-to-one mapping restricted to letters preserves each word's character count while unmapped punctuation, spaces and line breaks remain unchanged, so a small Python wrapper directly meets the ASCII-input requirement.

rows.name: Python standard library re and random
rows.reason: Python re/random preserves word lengths and unmatched punctuation/whitespace while generating random letters. Requires supplied script; strings may coincidentally be words. Documented API composition, not a separately tested application.

rows.name: GNU coreutils tr with an ASCII ROT13 mapping
rows.reason: FOSS Linux substitution of permitted ASCII letters preserves word lengths, punctuation, spaces and line breaks. Deterministic/reversible; tokens may become real words. No pronounceability or equal rendered-width promise.

rows.name: Lorem Picsum
rows.reason: Exclude: service takes image dimensions and returns placeholder photos. That image surface supplies no text-to-gibberish operation preserving original word lengths, punctuation and line breaks.

rows.name: Markovify default make_sentence (unmodified corpus-to-new-sentence generation)
rows.reason: Unmodified Markovify make_sentence generates new corpus-based sentences rather than replacing input words in place. It therefore does not preserve the input's word-length sequence, punctuation or line breaks.

rows.name: Markovify default make_sentence (unmodified corpus-to-new-sentence generation)
rows.reason: Default corpus-to-new-sentence generation does not preserve original word-length/separator sequences and rejects ordinary paired punctuation/quotes. This violates preservation; customization changes the evaluated configuration.
